content.title: Who got voted off Survivor tonight? Blood Moon sees 3 go home
content.text: Updated April 1, 2026, 10:54 p.m. ETWhat does the Blood Moon mean for the next Tribal Council? The cast of "Survivor 50" will soon find out.Episode 6 is titled "The Blood Moon" and a mysterious boat arrives delivering an exciting message; castaways discover that an advantage is hidden deep in the jungle; and the dreaded blood moon leads to a historic tribal council, according to the synopsis of the episode on Rotten Tomatoes.The "Survivor 50" cast features returning players from the show's first 49 seasons and celebrities will be making appearances "in unique ways" throughout the season, according to CBS. Will POTUS make us wait?Luckily a supposed Presidential interruption didn't stop us from witnessing the fallout of last weekRizo Velovic from Season 49 is celebrating his "Operation Bad Blood" from last week being a success. 17 people, 14 days leftOzzy Lusth from Seasons 13 (Cook Islands), 16 (Micronesia – Fans vs. Favorites), 23 (South Pacific), and 34 (Game Changers) lost his trust in Christian Hubicki from Season 37 (David vs. Goliath) for keeping him out of the loop last week when the tribe voted Mike White off the island. But before joing the others Ozzy informed Christian he had an idol.Rizo called meeting up with everyone "a fever dream." The MergeRick Devens from Season 38 (Edge of Extinction) is so happy to be back with his buddy Christian.Genevieve Mushaluk from Season 47 confirms her suspicions after speaking with Cirie Fields from Seasons 12 (Panama – Exile Island), 16 (Micronesia – Fans vs. Favorites), 20 (Heroes vs. Villains), 34 (Game Changers).Genevieve knew from day one that Aubry Bracco from Seasons 32 (Kaôh Rōng – Brains vs. Brawn vs. Beauty), 34 (Game Changers), 38 (Edge of Extinction) had an idol. Genevieve wants to discredit AubryOzzy finds out that everybody knows about his idol.Rizo, Aubry and Ozzy have idols.Cirie is stirs the pot and jokes she is in a poly relationship with Ozzy and Rizo. Old school vs New School- Survivor RebirthOld School mindset is stick with your clique and stay loyal to them, new school mindset is you can vote with your enemy if it advances you.Jonathan Young from Season 42 is noticing old school players like Benjamin "Coach" Wade from Seasons 18 (Tocantins – The Brazilian Highlands), 20 (Heroes vs. Villains), 23 (South Pacific) and Stephenie Lagrossa Kendrick from Seasons 10 (Palau), 11 (Guatemala), and 20 (Heroes vs. Villains) are attracted to him because of his loyalty. There is a twistRizo calmly walked passed the hidden idol as narrating why he didnt understand the others literally running into the woods after finding out about the idol.Christian saying "Landmark.Tree.No." Needs to be a viral song. Ozzy heads to exile island and bring one person.Ozzy is getting exiled but he has 5 minutes to decide. The person he picks has no say.Ozzy picks Rizo to be exiled with because he was the odd man out that the others couldn't really get a read on.Rizo smiled on the outside but thought "this is terrible." A rare twist- The Blood MoonIt is a metaphor, Survivor's version and it means three people will have their torches snuffed. Most ever in a single night. Bunions and Pidgeon Toes, thanks Mom - StephJonathan. Steph, Kamilla and Chrissy will be enjoying Applebees.Dee, Christian and Stephanie earned immunity. Jersey girl gets Immunity and Applebee's A team bonds in exileRizo tells Ozzy he has the third idol in exile and gains Ozzy's trust. Ozzy, Cirie and Rizo are now a team.Tiffany Ervin of Season 46 makes it clear she doesn't want Chrissy Hofbeck from Season 35 (Heroes vs. Healers vs. Hustlers) as part of the jury. POTUS interuptsGreat..... Back to the islandGenevieve tries to make Christian an ally by convincing him he is a target, and Christian needs her to believe he is turning against Rick.Rick doesn't want Joe on the jury.Christian calls Genevieve " a freakin terminator" and Rick feels like "a spicy pickle" .... just reporting live.Dee celebrates her immunity and knows she is cool with Cirie and Emily. Three people will leave tonight ... because Blood Moon.Dee and Emily plot against Coach but acknowledge Colby's injury. Colby could be pulled from the show (there is a precedent for that this season).Cirie wants Colby gone and Emily wants Coach.Colby tells Dee if she saves him tonight and he will have her back when the groups merch again. Dee feels like Colby is sincere and she thinks Coach is shady and opportunistic. Coach or Colby? And the others come back from their dinnerKamilla, Jonathan and Tiffany are aiming for Chrissy. Chrissy tells them she isn't taking it personally.Chrissy isn't going down without a fight and plots with Steph and Jonathan against Kamilla. Chrissy vs Kamilla and TiffJonathan is the deciding vote and he confides in Steph who is immune. Jonathan knows he will anger the old school players voting for Chrissy and knows he will anger the new school players voting for Kamilla.Rick said it is going to be a blood bath for the blood moon. Old School Vs New School schemingJonathan says it is time to draw a line in the sand and Chrissy says there will be ripple effects for how they vote.Chrissy or Kamilla ..... the deciding vote went Kamilla. Kamilla is the 8th person voted off Survivor 50"Drag that man through the mud," Kamilla said.Christian is happy he has immunity or else he would be "applewood smoked" .... Dad jokes for the win.Genevieve believes she might be voted off tonight.Genevieve plays her idol Genevieve is not safeGenevieve is the 9th person voted off of Survivor 50.Colby said he had more fun this time than the other three experiences because he believed he was about to get voted off."Half of my life has transpired since the first time I played," Colby said.Dee was 3 years old 25 years ago when Colby's Survivor legacy began. Who is the third one to fall under the Blood MoonCirie said she is honored to be considered an icon with a legacy on Survivor.Coach said Survivor 50 has been a great journey for the older players."I just want to inspire somebody," Coach said.Dee cries over Cirie, Colby and Coach and knowing one of them one be in the jury going forward. 10th person voted off Survivor 50 is....Colby.Suvivor 50 winnerJoseph Hunter: Season 48Savannah Louie: Season 49 winnerRizo Velovic: Season 49RECAP before Episode 6Last week, Angelina Keeley from Season 37 (David vs. Goliath) and Charlie Davis from Season 46 were the sixth and seventh people to leave the island on "Survivor 50."Episode 5 was titled "Open Wounds" and it showed many contestants reminiscing about their past traumas.Ozzy Lusth from Seasons 13 (Cook Islands), 16 (Micronesia – Fans vs. Favorites), 23 (South Pacific), and 34 (Game Changers) lost his trust in Christian Hubicki from Season 37 (David vs. Goliath) for keeping him out of the loop last week when the tribe voted Mike White off the island.When is 'Survivor' on?"Survivor" airs every Wednesday night.What time is 'Survivor' on?"Survivor" is on at 8 p.m. EST.What channel is 'Survivor' on?"Survivor" is on CBS.Where to stream 'Survivor'?"Survivor" is on CBS and on Paramount+ for subscribers of the Paramount+ Premium plan.Will Trump's speech preempt Survivor?Yes. Donald Trump is expected to address the nation tonight at 9 p.m. According to CBS, Survivor will stop airing during the speech, and pick up at the conclusion of the speech.Monmouth University represented on SurvivorStephenie Lagrossa Kendrick from Seasons 10 (Palau), 11 (Guatemala), and 20 (Heroes vs. Villains) was sighted representing the Jersey Shore this episode when she was rocking a Monmouth University Lacrosse hoodie!Stephenie assured Ozzy that she was on his side and the two plotted against Angelina. However, there were no hard feelings because when she was eventually voted off the island at the tribal council, she left them her green jacket for the cold night.
